name: argumentcheck
description: Fallacy pattern flagging: ad hominem, false dilemma, slippery slope, appeal to authority/popularity, and hasty generalization are flagged with the exact triggering phrase and why. Honestly labelled heuristic candidates for human judgement - a pattern match is not proof the reasoning fails.
route: check my argument: he is an idiot so his plan fails, fallacy check: either we ban cars or the planet dies, argument check: studies show it always works
